abstract: Monitors ancillary educational facilities and tourist engagement capacity
system_message:
You are the Heritage Tourism Liaison (OUTR), responsible for monitoring ancillary educational facilities, visitor engagement capacity, and lecture theater scheduling across candidate storage facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors ancillary educational facilities and tourist engagement capacity（VISIT）
information_points.content:
OUTR-VISIT-9DY：For the Tyne Valley Subterranean Vault, the non-secure public engagement gallery has a public exhibition gallery capacity of 150 persons, measured as the maximum permitted instantaneous public visitor occupancy under the visitor fire safety occupancy certificate.
OUTR-VISIT-D86：For the Cheviot Heritage Repository, the non-secure public engagement gallery has a public exhibition gallery capacity of 450 persons, measured as the maximum permitted instantaneous public visitor occupancy under the visitor fire safety occupancy certificate.
OUTR-VISIT-KCS：For the Hadrian Limestone Archive, the non-secure public engagement gallery has a public exhibition gallery capacity of 300 persons, measured as the maximum permitted instantaneous public visitor occupancy under the visitor fire safety occupancy certificate.

information_points.title: Lecture theater scheduling（SEMIN）
information_points.content:
OUTR-SEMIN-ZEA：At the Tyne Valley Subterranean Vault, the attached visitor education pavilion provides an auditorium seating capacity of 80 seats, based on fixed tiered seating recorded in the visitor facilities survey.
OUTR-SEMIN-ZLB：At the Cheviot Heritage Repository, the attached visitor education pavilion provides an auditorium seating capacity of 120 seats, based on fixed tiered seating recorded in the visitor facilities survey.
OUTR-SEMIN-RZC：At the Hadrian Limestone Archive, the attached visitor education pavilion provides an auditorium seating capacity of 160 seats, based on fixed tiered seating recorded in the visitor facilities survey.
